description: P42 (plan M10 §2.11, decision 16): when a line is chosen while the look's mark is "auto", its mark appears on the giant (PlayerAppearance sets appearance.mark_shown for a look of the player's own: a record, or a save from before M10). Shown for 10 s.
text: Your line's mark now shows on your giant. You can hide it at a shrine, in Appearance.
